reason: I would make the free CV on the website and maybe try the one free AI action, but I would not pay after that. Here a job comes from someone who knows you, so a nicer CV and a score going from 68 to 86 does not change much for me.
objection: A bit.ly link on WhatsApp asking for MoMo is exactly how my cousin got scammed. And even if it is real, what is the score worth if the boss hires his nephew anyway?
would_change_my_mind: Someone I know personally telling me they got called for an interview after using it, and a free try that shows me the result before I pay anything.
